body.es:
• Transporte: Translink Metro (autobuses y Glider). Con contactless tocas al subir y el sistema te cobra como máximo 4 £ al día. Usa la app mLink.
• Mayores: la 60+ SmartPass (60 a 64 años) y la Senior SmartPass (65+) dan viajes gratis; piden 3 meses viviendo en Irlanda del Norte.
• En Irlanda del Norte la vivienda y los servicios sociales NO los lleva el council: la vivienda social y el sinhogarismo son del Northern Ireland Housing Executive (NIHE), 03448 920 900. Los servicios sociales son del Belfast Health and Social Care Trust: infancia 028 9050 7000; adultos 028 9504 1744; urgencias fuera de horario 028 9504 9999.
• No hay council tax: pagas «rates», que cobra Land and Property Services.
body.en:
• Transport: Translink Metro (buses and Glider). With contactless you tap on and are charged at most £4 a day. Use the mLink app.
• Older people: the 60+ SmartPass (ages 60 to 64) and the Senior SmartPass (65+) give free travel; you need 3 months living in Northern Ireland.
• In Northern Ireland housing and social services are NOT run by the council: social housing and homelessness are handled by the Northern Ireland Housing Executive (NIHE), 03448 920 900. Social services are run by the Belfast Health and Social Care Trust: children 028 9050 7000; adults 028 9504 1744; out-of-hours emergencies 028 9504 9999.
• There is no council tax: you pay 'rates', collected by Land and Property Services.

say.en: In Belfast social housing is run by the Housing Executive, not the council. Social services are run by the Belfast Trust. And instead of council tax you pay rates.
